import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the supplied CSV and select London's observations.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')
london = df[df['city'] == 'London'].copy()

# Drop London's coldest day, then plot one temperature per date.
coldest_idx = london['temp_c'].idxmin()
london = london.drop(index=coldest_idx).sort_values('date')
grouped = london.groupby('date', as_index=False)['temp_c'].mean()

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot(grouped['date'], grouped['temp_c'], marker='o')
ax.set_xlabel('Date')
ax.set_ylabel('Temperature (°C)')
ax.set_title("London Temperature (Coldest Day Omitted)")
ax.set_ylim(0, grouped['temp_c'].max() * 1.1)
fig.autofmt_xdate()
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
